crew.overview: Justin Quayle is a low-level British diplomat who has always gone about his work very quietly, not causing any problems. But after his radical wife Tessa is killed he becomes determined to find out why, thrusting himself into the middle of a very dangerous conspiracy.
crew.title: The Constant Gardener

crew.original_title: The Boy Who Harnessed the Wind
crew.overview: Against all the odds, a thirteen year old boy in Malawi invents an unconventional way to save his family and village from famine.
crew.title: The Boy Who Harnessed the Wind

details.biography: Originally trained as a barrister, Gail established Potboiler Productions as one of the leading independent production companies in the UK, producing and executive producing over 20 films. Alongside her projects at Potboiler she has continued to collaborate with Mike Leigh’s Thin Man Films, executive producing Vera Drake, Happy-Go-Lucky, Another Year, Mr Turner, Peterloo and most recently, Hard Truths.
details.name: Gail Egan
